purpose: Falsify whether repaired advice retains source-specific value beyond a matched cheap source
primary_metric: oracle repaired expert value minus oracle repaired local_nominal value; paired episode average
fixed_control_selection: Select one fixed mode per source using validation only, then freeze before test
go_rule: Do not train a selector unless held-out source-specific oracle difference has positive episode CI, mean >= 1e-4, and contextual opportunity over the validation-selected fixed control has positive CI; necessary opportunity check only, oracle is not deployable
limitations: no claims of global information-theoretic value or full RTC reimplementation
